command:
bash -e -c snapper --in-place 2026-usrse/stamped-ai-study/README.md
snapper --check 2026-usrse/stamped-ai-study/README.md
uv run --offline --no-project --with cairosvg python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import cairosvg
from PIL import Image, ImageChops

folder = Path("2026-usrse/stamped-ai-study")
source = Path("../research/poster-context")
for name in ("stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg", "build_initial_poster.py", "stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png"):
    assert (folder / name).read_bytes() == (source / name).read_bytes(), name
    print("Source copy matches:", name)
svg = folder / "stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg"
original = svg.read_bytes()
root = ET.fromstring(original)
assert root.tag == "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg"
assert root.attrib["width"] == root.attrib["height"] == "44in"
assert root.attrib["viewBox"] == "0 0 3168 3168"
assert root.findall(".//{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}text")
subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(folder / "build_initial_poster.py")], check=True)
assert svg.read_bytes() == original, "Regenerated SVG differs"
proof = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stamped-ai-study-proof-")) / "preview.png"
cairosvg.svg2png(url=str(svg), write_to=str(proof), output_width=1584, output_height=1584)
with Image.open(proof) as rendered, Image.open(folder / "stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png") as supplied:
    assert rendered.size == supplied.size == (1584, 1584)
    difference = ImageChops.difference(rendered.convert("RGBA"), supplied.convert("RGBA"))
    assert not difference.getbbox(), "Rendered preview differs from supplied preview"
print("SVG XML, 44 × 44 inch size, editable text, and exact regeneration: valid")
print("CairoSVG version:", cairosvg.__version__)
print("Preview pixels match copied source; dimensions: 1584 × 1584")
print("Rendered preview:", proof)
print("SVG SHA-256:", hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest())
PY
